title: control.coordinator output
description: Shape the coordinator writes when handing off to the next role.

run_id.description: Stable id for the change run. Often a factory task id or a uuid hex.

next_role.description: Role id taking over the run.

artifact_ref.description: Path or URL pointing at the artifact the next role consumes.

rationale.description: One- or two-sentence reason for the handoff routing.
